headline: DRC imposes new cobalt export embargo to support prices
summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo has implemented a new embargo on cobalt exports to counter falling global prices. The country previously utilized a quota system after an initial 2025 ban.
why: The DRC is the world's largest producer of cobalt, a critical mineral for electric vehicle batteries. Export restrictions from the DRC directly impact global supply chains and commodity pricing.

impacts.name: Cobalt
impacts.why: Export restrictions reduce global supply, which typically puts upward pressure on prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The supply restriction is a direct attempt to tighten the market and reverse the downward trend in cobalt prices.
